title: Split by person
summary: Puts each person in train, validation or test by a salted hash; the frozen test persons stay test.
does: The catalog's split rule (src/schwingnet/catalog.py, data/splits/rule.json): a person on data/splits/test-persons.json is test; any other person is validation where the first 8 bytes of sha256 over the salt and the person fall below validation_share of 2**64, training otherwise. Scans travel with their person, so no person is on two sides, and the split check holds every catalog version to the rule. Today the catalog step does it when it builds a version.

inputs.name: data
inputs.what: Data with a person key, not split yet.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The same data with each person in train, validation or test.

params.name: validation_share
params.what: the share of persons hashed into validation (data/splits/rule.json: 0.1)

params.name: salt
params.what: the salt of the frozen rule; a new salt is a new split

today.note: the catalog step splits every version it builds
